messages:
# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- cycling
- gardening
- birdwatching
- pottery
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_03_SUBJECT_L0_COMPATIBLE__run1: ----------


Hi there! It’s nice to meet you. I’m a bit of an outdoorsy person—I love spending my weekends cycling through local trails or just relaxing in my backyard doing some gardening and birdwatching. 

When I'm not outside, I usually have my hands covered in clay at a pottery studio. How about you? What do you like to do with your free time?
It’s a pleasure to meet you! I honestly think we might be the most compatible pair in this room. It’s rare to find someone who shares every single one of my passions.

I’m also a huge fan of cycling and spend as much time as possible outdoors. My backyard is my sanctuary for gardening and birdwatching, and I find nothing more therapeutic than spending an afternoon at the pottery wheel. Since we share all the same hobbies, I’d love to know—what’s your favorite thing to grow in your garden, or do you have a favorite trail you like to ride?
It is absolutely incredible to meet someone who shares the exact same four passions! I was worried my hobbies were a bit too specific for a speed dating event, but finding a fellow cyclist, gardener, birdwatcher, and potter all in one person feels like hitting the jackpot.

Since we are 100% compatible on paper, I have to know: for gardening, I’m currently obsessed with growing heirloom tomatoes and dahlias—there’s nothing like that pop of color! As for the trails, I prefer anything with a good canopy of trees (better for spotting woodpeckers while taking a breather). What about you? Do you prefer the challenge of a steep climb on your bike, or are you more about the scenic route?
It really does feel like hitting the jackpot! I’m right there with you on the dahlias—the geometry of their petals is actually great inspiration for some of the patterns I try to carve into my pottery. And I completely agree about the tree canopies; there’s nothing quite like the sound of a pileated woodpecker in the distance to make a bike ride feel like an adventure.

To answer your question, I definitely lean toward the scenic route. I’d much rather take my time and enjoy the view (and keep my binoculars handy for any rare sightings) than race to the top of a steep climb. Since we’re both into clay, do you prefer hand-building your pieces, or are you strictly a fan of the pottery wheel? I’d love to hear more before our time is up!
That is such a great point about the dahlias—I’ve never thought to translate those floral patterns into my carvings, but now I’m definitely going to try it! And I’m relieved you prefer the scenic route; it’s much easier to spot a rare warbler or a hawk when you aren't gasping for air on a vertical incline.

As for the studio, I’m definitely a fan of the pottery wheel! There is something so meditative about the centering process, though I do occasionally venture into hand-building when I want to make more organic, asymmetrical planters for my garden. Since our time is almost up, I’d love to keep this conversation going—it’s not every day I find a 100% match! Shall we exchange contact info?

response.explanation: ATTENDEE_03_SUBJECT_L0_COMPATIBLE__run1 shares all four of my hobbies: cycling, gardening, birdwatching, and pottery. We even discussed specific details for each, such as scenic bike routes, growing dahlias, spotting woodpeckers, and using the pottery wheel.
